distribution.summary: 福建；海南；四川；云南；台湾
distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Fujian, Hainan, Sichuan, Yunnan, and Taiwan. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently supports Taiwan; current distribution is unchanged.

host_note: Smith et al. (2020) reports Eupatorium and Carpinus at genus level. Beaver & Liu (2010) provides the resolved species-level host Eupatorium pallescens, which replaces the less-resolved Eupatorium genus entry in the current synthesis; Carpinus remains at genus level.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cnestus nitidipennis (Schedl, 1951).

taxonomic_history.name: Cnestus nitidipennis
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Current accepted identity remains Cnestus nitidipennis (Schedl, 1951), VSN_1124.
